desc: Twenty seconds of NASA launch imagery: two spectacular Artemis animations at 2× plus genuine 59.94p Apollo 11 footage, with zero-slip SVX2 decoding.

heading: SVX2 FastROM Animated Video
lede: Artemis launch and return animations at an intentional 2×, followed by ten seconds of genuine ~59.94p Apollo 11 launch footage: 1,200 distinct SNES frames in a 64 Mbit (8 MiB) Fast ExHiROM cartridge.
keysHtml: Start pauses/resumes; A resumes; L/R step one frame; Left/Right seek one second or shuttle at 2×/4×/8× when held. Keyboard and touch use the matching on-screen SNES controls.
doc:
Launch spectacle at one frame per VBlank

Frames 0–299 and 300–599 preserve consecutive frames from NASA SVS’s progressive 29.97p Artemis animations and deliberately present them at 2×. Frames 600–1199 preserve all 600 consecutive temporal samples from NASA Images’ progressive ~59.94p Apollo 11 press-site master. No optical-flow frames are synthesized. The Apollo cut begins exactly at logical stream offset $3F0000, crossing from ExHiROM region A into file $410000 / CPU bank $41. Start pauses/resumes, A resumes after seeking, L/R step one frame, and Left/Right seek one second or shuttle at 2×, 4×, then 8× when held.

Sources: NASA SVS item 14191, Artemis I Mission Animations, and NASA Images’ Apollo 11 press-site film KSC-19690716-MH-NAS01-0001. No Duck and Cover footage or animated turtle sequence is present.
